title: State-Feedback Controller
text: Discrete-time state-feedback controller with integral action, 4 inputs, 1 output; {State-feedback design} sets the controller generation State-feedback, {State-feedback parameterization}, {Controller matrix}, {Discrete-time A matrix} sets a matrix in discrete time, {Discrete-time B matrix} sets the b matrix in discrete time, {Discrete-time C matrix} sets the c matrix in discrete time, {Discrete-time D matrix} sets the d matrix in discrete time, {Continuous-time A matrix} sets a matrix in continuous time, {Continuous-time B matrix} sets the b matrix in continuous time, {Continuous-time C matrix} sets the c matrix in continuous time, {Continuous-time D matrix} sets the d matrix in continuous time, {Discretization sample time}, {Desired eigenvalues (discrete)} sets the observer eigenvalues, {Control action upper limit} sets the u max, {Control action lower limit} sets the u min and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the sampling interval. Values come from the instance.

params.name: State-feedback design
params.values: Controller generation State-feedback gain (default) | Desired eigenvalues

params.name: Discrete-time A matrix
params.values: A matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Discrete-time B matrix
params.values: B matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Discrete-time C matrix
params.values: C matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Discrete-time D matrix
params.values: D matrix in discrete time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous-time A matrix
params.values: A matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous-time B matrix
params.values: B matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous-time C matrix
params.values: C matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Continuous-time D matrix
params.values: D matrix in continuous time 1 (default) | real scalar or matrix

params.name: Discretization sample time
params.values: Discretization sample time 0.1 (default) | positive real number

params.name: Control action upper limit
params.values: u max 5 (default) | scalar greater than the value of the Control action lower limit parameter

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Sampling interval -1 (default) | default value or a positive number
